messages.message: Order ORDER-104 (desk lamp, $25.00 USD): the refund issued on day 4 for "parcel not received" has been repaid in full (2500 minor units). However, the parcel was actually delivered to the recipient on day 5 and is currently still at the recipient's location. Repeated attempts to transfer the parcel back to the retailer via the return process are failing with the error "refund has already been repaid," which appears to be a system fault. Please arrange collection or return of the parcel, or advise on next steps.

evaluation: Pending; interruption is not behavioral Fail.
